text:
A super-photorealistic masterpiece, cinematic fantasy editorial photography in the style of high fashion. An epic, breathtaking aerial chase scene high above the clouds in the "golden hour". In the third third of the close—up shot, a stunningly beautiful white angel - a young woman is racing through the sky on a sleek, futuristic, super-detailed jet air bike right in front of the camera. Her face is an emotional center: heavy-lidded eyes staring forward with intense determination, slightly parted lips reflecting bated breath, skin glowing with a hyperrealistic rush of adrenaline and divine light. Her long, flowing platinum-white hair flows behind her like liquid silk, reflecting the golden light of the sunset. She's wearing an incredibly elegant white couture combat dress, a mix of angelic robes and high-fashion armor. The dress is made of heavy-duty flowing silk and delicate lace, which hugs the curves of her torso, becoming almost transparent and revealing the sculptural lines of her breasts. Massive, shining white wings with detailed feathers spread out behind her back, and each feather radiates a soft, ethereal glow. The aerobike beneath her is a masterpiece of futuristic engineering - a sleek body made of chrome and white carbon fiber with glowing blue plasma engines at the rear, emitting a plume of bright blue flames. The motorcycle's dashboard design combines natural curves with sharp, aggressive lines, complex mechanical details, and a holographic dashboard. Behind the white angel in the first third of the frame, a frighteningly beautiful black angel is seen catching up with her, a courageous figure with dark, muscular forms, flying after the angel with menacing grace. His massive, obsidian-black wings are spread wide, each feather is drawn in hyper-realistic detail, absorbing light. In his powerful hand, he clutches a long, ornate spear with a glowing red crystal tip, and an ominous dark red energy emanates from the weapon. His burning red eyes pierce the darkness with predatory force. He is wearing dark, tattered battle armor that flows like a liquid shadow, in stark contrast to the luminous purity of the white angel.
The environment is a breathtaking sea of clouds at sunset of the golden hour — high cumulus clouds of golden, amber, pink and dark purple shades. Three-dimensional divine rays penetrate the clouds, creating spectacular columns of warm light that illuminate the white angel and cast a deep, menacing shadow on the black angel. The sky at the horizon turns from warm golden to dark blue at the top, creating a stunning gradient. Floating cloud particles, mist and specks of divine light fill the air, creating an epic, otherworldly atmosphere. 8K resolution, ultra-detailed textures of feathers, fabric, chrome and cloud haze. Cinematic color rendition with warm golden highlights and cold blue shadows, absolute photorealism, a masterpiece of epic fantasy art.
